meta.description: EXAMPLE planning assumptions — fictional household. Copy to data/goals.json and replace with real numbers. Hand-maintained; the only place these planning figures are typed.

family.name: Alex & Jordan Example
family.framework: Deliberate allocation of time, energy, and money across career, relationships, and integrity.

profile.kevin: Person A (maps to balance key kevin). Example: software engineer, remote, primary W-2 income.
profile.hanna: Person B (maps to balance key hanna). Example: designer / founder, variable income.
profile.auPair: Optional childcare note — remove if N/A.
profile.kevinWork: Optional lifestyle note about Person A's work.

phases.label: P1
phases.name: Current — dual income
phases.note: Baseline phase. Income/expense keys are display labels; keep at least one expense named exactly like budget_tracking.joint.targetExpenseKey (default "Family budget").

phases.label: P2
phases.name: Higher earnings
phases.note: Example next phase — adjust years and numbers to the household.

phases.label: P3
phases.name: Semi-retirement
phases.note: Work optional. Expenses can be empty if using the P6-style slider later.

lifeGoals.name: Brokerage — long-term
lifeGoals.note: Set trackLiveBrokerage true to tie the card to live brokerage totals from accounts.json.

decisions.title: Example open decision
decisions.body: Replace with a real trade-off the household is deciding.

familyPlanning.note: Optional — family-size plans, or delete this object if unused.

careerOptions: Stay and grow in current role
